terminal_failures.condition: Qualified independent analysts given the same admissible pre-outcome evidence produce materially incompatible boundaries or constitutive-route structures beyond frozen tolerance.
Targeted loss of a declared required relation produces no selective change in the associated capacity or identity-conditioned route across an adequately powered admissible portfolio.
Unrelated capacity reliably restores a route whose declared required relation remains absent, without an admissible alternative route.
The invariant representation adds no reproducible selective prediction, provenance distinction, or restoration distinction beyond frozen generic graph and output-history comparators.
Identity-continuity classifications can be changed without observable consequence by arbitrary relabeling of routes or admissibility criteria.
The candidate survives only by changing boundaries, route topology, admissibility rules, thresholds, or exclusions after outcome inspection.
